note: Advisories this repo has looked at and accepted, each with the reason it cannot
reach anyone here. Patch it, or record the exemption and why (CON-SEC-003).
scripts/audit-deps.mjs fails if an entry here no longer matches a reported
advisory, so the list cannot outlive what it excuses. Re-read `reason` when the
advisory changes — the package name staying the same does not mean the same bug.

allowed.reason: libvips CVEs in Next's image optimiser. next.config.ts sets images.unoptimized, so sharp never processes an image in this build, and a static export has no image route at runtime.
XSS via an unescaped </style> in CSS stringify output. postcss runs at build time over this repo's own Tailwind sources; it never sees third-party or user input, and it is not in the shipped bundle.

Non-secure generator loops on a negative size. Reached only through postcss at build time. Verified absent from out/: the one `nanoid` string in the client bundle is Zod's .nanoid() validator method, not the package.
Browser downloads skip SSL certificate verification. Playwright is a peer dependency of next and is run only by developers and CI, never by a visitor. Nothing it installs reaches the deployed site.
Same advisory as playwright, reported once per package. See that entry.

Arbitrary file read and execution while the Vitest UI or API server is listening. This repo runs `vitest run` only; there is no --ui flag anywhere, @vitest/ui is not installed, and CI exposes no port. Fixed builds are 5.x, a major bump held for its own change.
Same advisory as vitest, reported through the coverage package. See that entry.
